label: prf:x5-bring-weight-identification
title: Proof of x5 bring weight identification
html:
Proof. Proof of x5 bring weight identification

Proof. Eigenvalue on \mathcal{X}_5: the automorphism \phi_5(x, y) = (\zeta_5 x, y) pulls back the coordinate function x to (\phi_5^{-1})^{*}(x) = \zeta_5^{-1} x under the left-action convention \sigma \cdot f = f \circ \sigma^{-1}, so x is an eigenvector with eigenvalue \zeta_5^{-1}.

Eigenvalue on Bring: the cyclic permutation \sigma(x_j) = x_{j+1} diagonalises on the Lagrange resolvents as \sigma(w_k) = \zeta_5^{-k} w_k (prop:lagrange-resolvent-transform); specialising to k = 1 gives \sigma(w_1) = \zeta_5^{-1} w_1.

Both x and w_1 span their respective weight-(-1) eigenspaces (one-dimensional in each coordinate ring). The linear map x \mapsto w_1 is therefore a canonical \mathbb{Z}_5-equivariant isomorphism of weight-(-1) subspaces, and the extension to powers x^{k} \mapsto w_1^{\,k} carries weight \zeta_5^{-k} on both sides, hence is \mathbb{Z}_5-equivariant on the five-term cyclic isotypical decomposition. \square
